data.long_meaning: The name Birkett is derived from the Old English word 'bircet', meaning bright or clear. It was a common surname in England during the Middle Ages and was often given to children born in sunny conditions. The name Birkett carries the meaning “Bright or clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Birkett usually hope their child will grow to embody bright or clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
